_about: Corpus checks of exclusions the manuscript states; gathered by hand on COCA 2026-09-17, screened by TypeSafe, residue read (corpus/exclusion_tests/readings.md). Builds analysis/generated/exclusion-table.tex via analysis/tools/exclusion_table.py.

checks.result: no ordinary fused-head use; \mention{every} in ellipsis (\mention{if not every, then almost every N}), reply fragments, and binomials (\mention{any and every}); slips for \mention{everyone} in informal text

checks.claim: Degree adverb on a non-gradable determinative (\ungram{\mention{very every}}, \ungram{\mention{very some}}, \ungram{\mention{very this}})
checks.result: no qualifying line; two jocular cases (\mention{very this}, \mention{very this year})

checks.claim: Reversed order (\ungram{\mention{very a few}}, \ungram{\mention{a quite few}})

checks.result: none for \mention{so}; three marginal web lines for \mention{too} (\mention{too numerous inaccuracies})

checks.claim: Compounds exclude an article and a pre-head adjective
checks.result: attested at volume and productively (\mention{an anonymous someone}, \mention{a furry something}, \mention{such an anyone})

checks.claim: Singular agreement with \mention{each of the people}
checks.result: plural agreement in a sixth of tokens after \mention{each of them}, in every register
